entities.name: Hugo Grotius
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dutch jurist (1583-1645) known as the "Father of International Law" for his groundbreaking work De Jure Belli ac Pacis (On the Law of War and Peace, 1625). Grotius argued that natural law bound nations even in war, establishing principles of sovereignty, freedom of the seas, and just war theory that underpin modern international law.
